rootCause: NativeFunctionDeclaration grammar lacked the public modifier accepted by CSharp. The compact AST selected public as name and version as a synthetic primary parameter. Native status/out handling only inspected the first raw token.
decisions: Native header order is optional try, optional public, then function name and optional named input, matching CSharp ParseNativeBlock then ParseFunctionDeclaration.
Compact AST must preserve source span while advancing signature-header end beyond the actual name; visibility and status/out flags survive modifiers and trivia.
Public visibility must be added once, even when the native header and generic visibility pass both observe it.
